briefdescription.para: Bit positions at which the fields of a point in time are packed into a single value.
This function returns a packed date/time value (Year/Month/Day/Hour/Minute/Second) used for ordering comparisons (monotonic by fields).

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to XAsu_X509Time structure which holds the point in time.

listitem.para: The point in time as a value which increases monotonically with time.

briefdescription.para: This function validates the OCP certificate parameters.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to XAsu_OcpCertParams structure which holds the parameters of OCP input argument.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if OCP certificate parameters are validated successfully.
XST_FAILURE, if OCP certificate parameters validation is failed.

briefdescription.para: This function validates the OCP DevAk attestation parameters.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if OCP attestation parameters are validated successfully.

briefdescription.para: This function validates the user X.509 certificate request parameters.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to XAsu_OcpUserCertParams structure which holds the user certificate request parameters.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if user certificate request parameters are validated successfully.
XST_FAILURE, if user certificate request parameters validation is failed.

briefdescription.para: This function validates the user supplied configuration of a user X.509 certificate.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to XAsu_X509UserCertCfg structure which holds the certificate fields, the key usage and the key identifiers.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS, if user certificate configuration is validated successfully.
XST_FAILURE, if user certificate configuration validation is failed.

inbodydescription.para: Validate the user certificate configuration pointer.
Validate the year of the validity period.
Validate the ordering of the validity period, as a certificate whose validity period ends before it starts is expired the moment it is issued.
Validate the key identifiers of the subject public key and of the issuer key pair.
